messages:
maria: kicking off offline delivery for sealed-bundle v1.9.0-rc2. planning a transport handoff to the carrier during the 03:00 UTC maintenance window. tagging artifacts with semver+shard so mirrors can dedupe.

tom: oncall cleared the window (02:45-04:15 UTC). infra team ok with network egress carveout. will coordinate with carrier ops.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] build finished for sealed-bundle:v1.9.0-rc2
checksum: sha256:3f8a7c9b2d4e6f0a9c1b2e3d4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3
artifact-size: 1.2GB
build-id: build-285412-rc2

lu: sending signer queue now. note: cosign key rotated yesterday; current KMS alias = projects/redwood/keys/release-rot3. carrier needs the new public key bundle.

sandhya: quick manifest check: there's a tiny delta in config-snap that affects preflight script path. adding a hardened fallback to the installer preflight to avoid false-positive failures. snippet below for reviewers:
```
manifest:
  epoch: 42
  transport: offline-mirror
  artifacts:
    - name: runtime-image
      digest: sha256:3f8a7c9b2d4e6f0a9c1b2e3d4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3
    - name: installer-init
      digest: sha256:deafbeef00cafe1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12
    - name: config-snap
      digest: sha256:00ff11ee22dd33cc44bb55aa66dd77cc88ee99ff00112233445566778899aabb
```

nick: good call. if a preflight fails at the customer site, what's the immediate rollback play? do we revert the epoch pointer or instruct carrier to withhold distribution?

maria: rollback outline: 1) instruct carrier to hold the seal (do not apply transport manifest) 2) revert epoch pointer in our staging transport manifest (set epoch to previous stable 41) 3) if needed, trigger a rebuild with the config-snap fix and re-sign. critical: do NOT rotate public tags in any registry during rollback window. postmortem if we hit customer-facing failure.

deploy-bot: [SCHEDULE] handoff to carrier scheduled for 2026-03-11 03:05:00 UTC. deploy-id: db-2854123456-rc2. preflight scheduled at 02:40 UTC.

pkg-eng: I'll tail mirror validation and checksum propagation once handoff occurs. if digest mismatch appears, I'll open an emergency republish and notify @maria and @tom. plan for a 15m backout if mirrors don't converge.

tom: copy. @deploy-bot please run the preflight hooks at 02:40 and post success/failure with logs. add a small delay step (30s) between signing and carrier handoff to allow manual abort.

maria: thanks everyone — prepping the release notes now. will include runbook steps for manual rollback, the cosign pubkey fingerprint, and the carrier contact list.

sandhya: adding the runbook snippet to the docs site after CI completes; will paste the link here once it's available. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: [RESULT] preflight passed at 02:40 UTC, all checks green. staging seal created but not published. awaiting manual 30s hold and carrier confirmation.

pkg-eng: mirror checksumming OK from staging edge. ready to proceed at my mark.

maria: proceed. handing off to carrier in T-10s.

deploy-bot: [COMPLETE] carrier accepted sealed-bundle:v1.9.0-rc2 at 03:05 UTC. transport manifest applied. deploy-id: db-2854123456-rc2. :rocket:

nick: noted. monitoring customer channels for any immediate regressions.

maria: great work. keeping the rollback plan live for 2 hours post-delivery then deprecating until next release. will file a concise release note in the repo.
